type.description: Discriminant for the envelope variant. Five values were observed on Codex >= 0.45 rollouts in 2026-05; two more (world_state, inter_agent_communication_metadata) were measured on 2026-08-13 across the 60 largest rollouts on the reference machine, written by CLI 0.144.0-alpha.4 through 0.146.0-alpha.3.1. Both of the new ones are metadata rather than conversation and are deliberately skipped by the parser, but they are enumerated here so the P9.2 unknown-payload counter reports genuine drift rather than a permanent background hum.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which Codex emitted the line.

payload.description: Variant-specific payload. Schemas for each variant live in the Codex CLI source; this fixture only enforces top-level envelope shape.

_meta.source: hand-coded fallback; replace via 'node scripts/regen-codex-schema.js' when a Codex CLI with 'app-server generate-internal-json-schema' is installed

driftLog.method: type histogram over the 60 largest rollouts under $CODEX_HOME/sessions, read-only
driftLog.note: Regenerating this fixture from the CLI will drop these two unless the CLI's own schema has caught up. Re-measure before trusting a regenerated enum.
